items.q: Whenever anybody got sick, we had the band doctor and a guy by the name of Frenchie was the road manager... he arranged transportation and hotels, paid off the boys.

ctx.x: On this tour, Louie always carried a doctor and a road manager. Whenever anybody got sick, we had the band doctor and a guy by the name of Frenchie was the road manager, he arranged transportation and hotels, paid off the boys. Many nights we got money before we even went to work because he'd get it in cash and distribute it before the job. That's the way Louie operated the band.
